title: CCNA Study Materials
description: Certification resource recommendations, my own Anki deck I used to study, and a PacketTracer lab to get you ready for the big day.
summary: The CCNA is a difficult exam that took me roughly a year to earn. It is a difficult, but extremely valuable certification. For my studies, I primarily used Neil Anderson's CCNA course along with the flashcards he provides. Alongside that, I am linking a free course on YouTube that I watched sometimes. In the below resources, I have provided my own Anki deck covering command syntax as well as a PacketTracer lab that I completed several times prior to my exam.
